title: Landnam mission template
description: A mission type: the beats a player goes through, the controls each beat uses and how it ends. Every mission resolves to one template. Compiled into shared/missions/mission-templates.json, which web and native both read.

id.description: Stable template id. Missions name it in their `template` field.

family.description: contract: a client pays for the job. program: the player builds their own base and space program. feed: data a probe or satellite sends home, worked in a classification scene. event: a limited-time fork of another template.

fork_of.description: Events only: the template this event forks. Its beats are inherited; beats here with the same id replace them, new ids are appended before the last beat.

window.description: Events only: when the event runs, in plain language.

summary.description: One sentence: what the player does and why.

methods.description: How the work is done, picked before launch; the first is the default. Mining: the ship's laser from orbit (default) or a rover on the surface. Beats with a `method` play only for that method. Events inherit their fork's methods.

sources.description: Feeds only: the templates whose hardware sends this data home.

match.description: How a runtime mission (generated, story or event) resolves to this template when it does not name one. Ids beat prefixes, prefixes beat tags.

label.description: One or two words shown as the step name.

view.description: Which kind of screen the beat plays on. orbit and field are the TakeOn 3D field (KES-543): orbit rides the ship on a low pass, field chases a rover or lander on the surface.

goal.description: The one line the player reads.

repeat.description: The beat can loop (several hauls, several sectors).

method.description: Plays only when the player picked this method. Omit for beats every method shares.
